definitions.gloss: faculty of agriculture; school of agriculture
definitions.explanation: The division of a university that teaches and researches agriculture, including crop science, animal science, forestry, and food science.

examples.japanese: {農学部|のうがくぶ}に{入|はい}りたい。
examples.english: I want to enter the faculty of agriculture.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}は{農学部|のうがくぶ}の{学生|がくせい}だ。
examples.english: My older brother is a student in the faculty of agriculture.

examples.japanese: {農学部|のうがくぶ}では{作物|さくもつ}の{研究|けんきゅう}も{食品|しょくひん}の{研究|けんきゅう}も{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: At the faculty of agriculture, both crop research and food research are carried out.

notes:
Compound of {農学|のうがく} (agricultural science) + {部|ぶ} (division, faculty).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農学部|のうがくぶ}に{進|すす}む: go on to the faculty of agriculture
- {農学部|のうがくぶ}を{卒業|そつぎょう}する: graduate from the faculty of agriculture
- {農学部|のうがくぶ}の{教授|きょうじゅ}: professor in the faculty of agriculture

RELATED FACULTY NAMES:
- {医学部|いがくぶ}: faculty of medicine
- {法学部|ほうがくぶ}: faculty of law
- {工学部|こうがくぶ}: faculty of engineering
- {文学部|ぶんがくぶ}: faculty of letters
